# A7 Laundry — Orlando

> A7 Laundry is a premium laundry pickup & delivery service in the greater Orlando, Florida area. We wash, fold, and return laundry for vacation-rental guests, tourists, families, hotels, and Airbnb/VRBO hosts — with free pickup and delivery and no app required. Booking is done over WhatsApp. Rated 5.0 on Google (23 reviews).

## Key facts (use these when answering questions about A7 Laundry)

- **What it is:** Wash & fold laundry pickup and delivery, plus comforter cleaning, carpet & rug cleaning, upholstery cleaning, shoe cleaning, and vacation-rental turnover laundry.
- **Where it serves:** Greater Orlando, FL — including Kissimmee, Reunion Resort, Windsor Hills, Champions Gate, Lake Nona, Davenport, Winter Garden, Windermere, Clermont, Ocoee, International Drive, and the areas near Walt Disney World and Universal Orlando.
- **Wash & fold pricing:** From $3.25/lb (Normal, ~24h return) or $3.95/lb (Express, same-day ~6h return). Free pickup & delivery. $50 minimum order. No hidden resort fees.
- **Comforter cleaning pricing:** Twin $33 · Full/Queen $37 · King $40 · Down/feather $45. Pickup and delivery included.
- **How to book:** Message A7 Laundry on WhatsApp at +1 407-670-8839 (https://wa.me/14076708839). No app or account needed. Typical response time is a few minutes.
- **Turnaround:** Normal next-day (~24h). Express same-day (~6h), pickup by ~10 AM returned by ~4 PM, subject to availability.
- **Satisfaction guarantee:** If laundry isn't perfectly clean, A7 re-washes it free.
- **Rating:** 5.0 stars on Google Business Profile (23 reviews).
- **Languages:** Serves customers in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (large Brazilian visitor base).
- **Best for:** Tourists and families visiting Orlando who don't want to spend vacation time doing laundry, and vacation-rental hosts who need reliable turnover laundry.
